content: The kwenhe renhe areke nhenge chair mwerre akngerre anthurre-arle anemeke pipe imarteye-iweke-arle iltye akwe-arratyele arntwirrkerlenge. Arrpenhele angkentye areye intelhe-ileke-arle arrekweleke ingkerneke-arlke pipe yanhe ikwere. Arrpenhele angkentye yanhe areye read-eme-iletyakenhe aneke arrpenhele-arle kwenhe ankere apurte-arteke 7 pipe-ke-arleke arrernerlenge itnenhe ayernemele nhenge altywere-irreme-ketye.

The anteme alkere-arenye lterrke anthurre areke arnterre angkerlenge. Alakenhe kwenhe re angkeke, “Angwenhe-ame aneme Ngkartele-arle akngakekeke ankere nhenge ularte-iwetyeke pipe renhe altywere-iletyeke? Artwe mwerre anthurrele-ante kwenhe renhe altywere-iletyeke.”

Kele itne apmere arrpe-anenhe areke imerte arrpenheke uyarne untheke nhenge ankere renhe-arle ularte-iwetyeke pipe renhe altywere-iletyeke renhe aretyeke, itne-arle alkerenge uthene ahelhenge uthene kwenhe apale-untheke artwe mwerre anthurre anyenteke-ante, nhenge ahelhe kwenenge-arlke kwenhe itne uyarne untheke, arrangkwe-akwete-arle aneke.
Nhenge the nhenhe renhe aremele ayenge arnterre anthurre artneke itne-arle artwe mwerre anyenteke uyarne anthurre unthekenge pipe renhe altywere-iletyeke renhe aretyeke.

Kele alartetye anyente anteme atyenge angkeke, “Artnetyale anaye! Araye, lterrke akngerre anyente-arle lion-arteke-arle nhakwe tnerlenge Judah-eke artweye areye-ngentyele. Re kwenhe arratye mwerre anthurre aneme, Re kwenhe alartetye David-kenheke artweye-ngentyele aneme, re ilyenpenye anthurre; atwentye arrpenhe anthurre. Re kwenhe ameke-arle-areye aneke. Alakenhe ikwerenge anteme rarle thewe pipe renhe-arle inetyeke ankere renhe ularte-iwemele altywere-iletyenhe imerte renhe aremele.”
Ikwere-iperrele anteme the areke yepe-yepe urreye akweke

tnerle-anerlenge chair mwerre akngerre ikwere itwele nhenge atnunthe arlpelhe-akerte 4-pele mpwepele alartetye 24 areyele-arlke. Nhenge the Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke areke imerte ayenge itirremele, “Renhe apeke arrpenhele akwele irrerlknge atweke, re akenhe awethe itethe-anteme-irrirtneke.” The areke rarle rulye-rulye seven-akerte alknge seven-akerte anerlenge. Alknge seven yanhe areye aneke utnenge seven Ngkartele-arle apmere ahelhe nhenhe itepe arrpe-anenhe-werne yernekeke.
Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke yanhe alheke pipe imarteye-iweke-arle renhe arrpenhe-ngentyele inemele chair anyente-arle anekeke renhe iltye akwe-arratye ikwerenhele arntwirrkemele.

Nhenge re pipe ineke-arle, atnunthe arlpelhe-akerte four-pele uthene alartetye twenty-four uthene Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke ikwerenge arrekwele ulperre inteke inngerre kwene-akerle renhe tnaketyeke. Itne arrpe-anenhele arne guitar-arteke atnyeneke, apanthe-arlke gold-engentyele-arle mpwarekeke. Apanthe areye-ngentyele kwerte ntyentye mwerre akngerre Ngkarteke akertne-atheke urnteme, nhenge re kwerte mwerre akngerre ntyernemele Re atnerte akangkentye anthurre aneke. Kwerte nhenhe kwenhe alakenhe-arteke aneke nhenge atyewe Ngkarte-kenhe areye Ikwere angkeme. Re itnenhe aweke akangkemele anteme aneme, nhenge alakenhe-arteke re kwerte ntyentye mwerre akngerre ntyernemele.
Kele imerte atnunthe four-pele uthene alartetye twenty-four uthene Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke ikwere alyelhentye arrpenhe alakenhe alyelhemele:

content.text: “Unte anyente ware kwenhe arratye mwerre anthurre-ulkere aneme pipe imarteye-iweke-arle inetyeke renhe altywere-iletyeke.
Unte-ante ware kwenhe ankere ularte-iwetyeke renhe altywere-iletyeke,
unte-arle kwenhe anwerneke piwelhemele ilweke, arrule anthurre-arle,
alhwe ngkwinhe tyerrtye ingkirreke apmere arrpe-anenhe-arenye areyeke thelelhemele.
Unte tyerrtye areye itetheke mpwareke angkentye arrpenhe-arle angkemeke, tyerrtye areye yenpe arlkenye arrpenhe-akerte-arle, tyerrtye areye apmere arrpe-anenhe-arenye areye-arle.
Unte itnenhe Ngkarte-werne akngetye-alpeke, nhenge yanhe-ngentyele itne Ikwerenhe anetyenhenge.
Kele itnekenhe alartetye irreke-arle unte itnenhe kwertengerle tyatye-kenhe areye anetyeke arrerneke warrke Ngkarte-kenhe aywerrkele mpwarerlte-anetyeke,
arlte urreke-arle anteme itne tyerrtye ingkirreke anthurre arntarnte-areme anteme apmere ahelhe nhenhele-arle anemeke.”

content: Nhenge the akwete aretyame the alkere-arenye atningke anthurre areke, arunthe anthurre itne aneke, yerre areye-arteke. Itne kwenhe chair mwerre akngerre yanhele itepe arrpe-anenhe tnetyame, atnunthe four-pele areye-arlke alartetye twenty-four areye-arlke.
The itnenhe ingkirreke anthurre alyelherlenge aweke, arnterre anthurre alakenhe arlkemele:

content.text: “Anwerne Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke yanhe renhe akwetethe akertne utyernerlte-aneye! Renhe-arle itne irrerlknge atweke, kenhe re akenhe awethe-arle itethe-irrirtnerlenge, re mwerre akngerre anthurre aneme.
Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke yanhe re alartetye anthurre anwerne-kenhe aneme Utnenge Ngkarte-kenhe-akerte,
nhenge arne ingkirreke atnyenemele, re itnenhe akwetethe mwantyele antherle-aneme.
Re kwenhe akaperte altywere anthurre aneme, arratye akwetethe itirrerle-aneme,
Kele anwerne renhe akwetethe akertne utyernerlte-anemele tnakewarreye.”

content: Ikwere iperrele anteme the arne ingkirreke alyelherlenge aweke Ngkartele-arle mpwarekeke, tyerrtye-arlke, atnunthe-arlke, thipe-arlke, irrpennge-arlke, arne ingkirreke apmere ahelhele-arle anemeke, alkerele-arlke, kwatye kwenele-arlke. Itne ingkirreke alakenhe alyelheke:

content.text: “Tyerrtye ingkirrekele kwenhe yanhe renhe akertne utyernerlte-anemele tnaketyeke, renhe chair mwerre akngerrele-arle anerle-anemeke! Itne Yepe-Yepe Akwerrke akwetethe akertne utyernerlte-anemele tnaketyeke!
Yanhe atherre kwenhe arratye mwerre akngerre aneme, nhenge arne ingkirreke ilyernpenye anthurre mpwaretyeke, Ratherre apmere arrpe-anenheke alartetye anerle-anerremele.
Kele anwerne ikwere-atherre akangkemele artepe kwene-irremele, akwetethe alyelhemele, tnakemele anteye, akwetethenhe-akwetethe!”

content: Nhenge itne alyelhentye uyerremele, atnunthe four-pele chair akngerre-apenhe yanhe ikwere-arle itwele tnetyameke, alakenhe angkemele, “Yewe, yanhe kwenhe mwerre anthurre-arle!” Alartetye 24 areye artepe kwene-irremele anteye Renhe akertne utyernemele tnakeke.

footnotes.text: Yepe-yepe urreye akweke nhenhe kwenhe Jesus Christ-arle aneme.
